newsitem.title: USA: Two frost systems likely in U.S. Midwest this week.
newsitem.headline: Two frost systems likely in U.S. Midwest this week.

text.p: Two cold weather systems, which some meteorologists expect will produce scattered frost, were forecast for the U.S. Midwest this week with the first system expected to arrive late Monday.

Temperatures from the low to mid 30s degrees Fahrenheit were forecast for early Tuesday morning for southern South Dakota and western Minnesota and early Wednesday morning for southeast Minnesota and northern Iowa, said Joel Burgio, Weather Services Corp meteorologist.
Temperatures in the low 30s could extend into western Illinois early Wednesday morning with some frost, Burgio said.
Frost in this first system may cause scattered damage to corn and soybeans in low-lying areas, but Burgio said losses may be more severe from the second system due late Thursday.
"The best potential (to end the growing season) is with the second one," he said.
Weather Express Inc meteorologist Fred Gesser said Indiana and Ohio should be safe from frost this week.
